reason: If the free tricks actually fool my friends at the next party, 99 shekels for lifetime is nothing to me, I'd pay that night just to have more tricks for the WhatsApp crowd. But I only pay after a free trick works, not before.
objection: I'm not a magician, so if the trick needs smooth talking or fast fingers I'll mess it up in front of everyone and look stupid. Also installing from a browser and putting my card on some random site instead of the App Store feels a bit sketchy.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trick flops or is too complicated to pull off the first time, I won't pay.
